## Embedding compressibility {#crop-compressibility .smaller}

PCA stats at [95%]{.hl} variance explained

| Model               | Extraction     | PCA components | % of PCA components to embedding dimensions |
|:--------------------|:---------------|:--------------:|:-------------------------------------------:|
| Prithvi EO 2.0 300M | All Embeddings | 303            | 1.74%                                       |
| Prithvi EO 2.0 600M | All Embeddings | 244            | 0.52%                                       |
| TerraMind Base      | All Embeddings | 129            | 1.05%                                       |
| TerraMind Large     | All Embeddings | 128            | 0.78%                                       |
| Prithvi EO 2.0 300M | June           | 208            | 5.08%                                       |
| Prithvi EO 2.0 600M | June           | 179            | 1.55%                                       |
| TerraMind Base      | June           | 77             | 2.51%                                       |
| TerraMind Large     | June           | 79             | 1.93%                                       |

[All models only have Sentinel-2 L2A as input.]{.muted}
